name: Power Electronic Converters and Control for E-Mobility
description: Introduction to Power Electronic Converters for E-Mobility, History of EVs. Storage System – Battery, BMS, Active Cell Balancing. EV Powertrain – architecture and control, traction inverter design with HV battery pack. EV Charging – On Board Chargers (topologies and control), Partial Power Processing. High Power Charging (EVs, Marine Vehicles), MV grid-connected charging, Renewable Assisted Charging. Railway Traction Converters and Auxiliary Power Conversion (Topologies and Control). Architecture of Aerospace and Marine Vehicles, Its Power Distribution, and More Electric Aircraft.
